_doc: The loading screen's and the Play menu's photographs (assets/ui/photo/<id>.jpg), staged in the game itself and rendered by ./skate photos (tools/photos.ts, src/client/photo.ts): docs/art-direction.md's house treatment, black and white fisheye flash pictures like an early-2000s skate magazine. No image model, no real people: the cast at the game's own places. Per photo: world and weather; skater (a scenario at a tick with the state it must be in, or stood at x y with the board's heading in degrees, 0 = +x; character; hidden); camera (orbit [az from behind the tail, el, dist, lookUp, ahead] or pos and look; shift moves the look point; roll in degrees; fov the lens, horizontal degrees); figures (model, state walk = on foot or ground = on the board, at x y or near [right, ahead] of the skater, face degrees or camera or skater, ticks and tick for the idle fidgets, emote ticks since it began, react cheer point wait at the skater, pose = a name in poses or poses.json fields over base, only board, hideBoard, lift); flash (a point light up and to the side of the lens, ambient scales the daylight) and develop (the darkroom: lens, image circle, levels, curve, grain, halation) override the defaults below. size is the file, render the oversampling of the wide render before the lens bends it. poses.sit: sat on its own board on the ground (hips low enough that no character's legs lift it).
